claims.text: The governing distance measurement is the trace, not the rounded trip-record copy. gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 14.56 km against a booked optimal of 11.4 km, an excess of 3.16 km, and POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure to be used where the two distance fields disagree.

Both establishment gates of POL-RD-01 are passed on that trace: the excess of 3.16 km is greater than the 0.8 km absolute threshold, and 27.72% is greater than the 20% proportional threshold. The route deviation is therefore ESTABLISHED.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 115 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds. None of limbs (a) to (c) is engaged, so the deviation may be established on the trace alone and no independent corroboration is required.

The driver's explanation in his counterparty statement - 'traffic was heavy so I took another road' - fails at the artifact it needs. The only traffic advisory associated with this trip, EV-ADVIS-02802-01, is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0, no payload) and the derived advisory area for this trip returns an empty advisory list. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run and, under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08, the driver's uncited traffic assertion carries no weight.

The absent advisory does not escalate this case. The driver cited no evidence identifier for any advisory, and under POL-RD-13 an assertion that names no artifact cannot be an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5); the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it. The deviation stands at the measured figure under POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route of 11.4 km.

No rider-requested detour can excuse any part of the excess: the chat log for this trip carries 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint and nothing capable of satisfying POL-RD-04(a) to (c). The driver has pointed to no chat_log artifact at all.

There was no relocation of the pickup or drop-off. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-quote and the booked 11.4 km optimal route is the correct baseline.

This was not a pooled trip. trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_X and not RYDE_POOL, so the matched-itinerary baseline of POL-RD-12 does not apply and the single-rider optimal of 11.4 km is the field against which the excess is properly measured.

POL-RD-11 does not close off the distance refund. fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED, not UPFRONT_QUOTE, and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so the fare was not fixed at booking and POL-RD-02 governs the recomputation.

The POL-RD-02 arithmetic yields a refund of SGD 3.41: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 11.4 + 0.28 x 15.4) x surge 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 17.4620, and charged_total 20.87 less 17.4620 = 3.4080, rounded up to the next SGD 0.05, which is SGD 3.45.
The surge multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, which is 1.0 for this trip, so no surge uplift enters the recomputation; the trip_record does not carry the field at all.
The refund is well above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 16.33% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share. The correct outcome is therefore PARTIAL_REFUND, not NO_ACTION and not FULL_REFUND.

The refund is not capped by the SGD 2.50 figure the rider entered as the amount contested. POL-RD-02 defines the refund as charged_total less recomputed_fare, floored at zero and rounded up to the next SGD 0.05, and on this fare that figure is SGD 3.45; the contested sum is the rider's estimate, not the policy measure.

There is no pass-through correction to add and nothing to double count. The fare breakdown itemises no ERP gantry lines and no airport surcharge (off_optimal_route_total 0.00 and on_optimal_route_total 0.00), so the POL-RD-02 figure of SGD 3.45 stands alone as the single money movement under POL-RD-09.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. Limb (a): trip id TRP-02802 and the pickup start time 2026-09-11T07:45:05+08:00 appear consistently on the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown. Limb (b): the excess of 3.16 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold and is measured from an unimpaired trace. The burden shifts to the driver, who has pointed to no specific artifact and no specific clause.

ruling.explanation:
Rider, your dispute of the metered fare is upheld in part; Driver, the excess distance on this trip is not excused.

THE DEVIATION. This was trip TRP-02802 (11 Sep 2026, Northpoint City to Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4), a metered fare, with a booked optimal route of 11.4 km. POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure where the trace and the trip record disagree: EV-GPS-02802 records 14.56 km against the trip record's rounded 14.60 km copy. The excess is 3.16 km, or 27.72% of optimal, which clears both establishment gates (over 0.8 km and over 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL (3.16 km is below 8.0 km and 27.72% is below 50%), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered; in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 295 trips, far below the pattern thresholds, and POL-GEN-01 confines that check to those two fields only. No driver-conduct referral arises.

TRACE QUALITY. The trace carries 115 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0 seconds. It fails none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c), so it is not impaired for policy purposes, the excess is measured on it directly, and no independent corroboration is required.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE. Driver, your statement that traffic was heavy so you took another road is an external-traffic-cause excuse. Under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. That advisory, EV-ADVIS-02802-01, is MISSING (no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and, under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13, the assertion carries no weight. It neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route. No rider-requested detour applies (chat log EV-CHAT-02802 carries 0 messages, POL-RD-04), no pickup or drop-off amendment applies (POL-RD-05), and this is not a pooled trip (vehicle type RYDE_X, POL-RD-12).

WHY THIS DOES NOT ESCALATE. The driver's side asks that the case be held under POL-RD-10(5) because the advisory identifier is missing. I decline. POL-RD-13 addresses this exact situation: where the asserting party names no evidence ID for an advisory, the missing advisory is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5) - the absence is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, and the deviation stands at the measured figure with POL-RD-02 running against the booked 11.4 km optimal. The driver's own statement names no advisory, and the minted identifier is cited on both sides only as an absence, not as the ground of the excuse. No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across the three artifacts, the trace is not impaired, the timestamps agree, and no charge line is unmatched.

THE REFUND (POL-RD-02). The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02802), so POL-RD-11 does not apply; the surge multiplier of 1.0 was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier. charged_total = 20.87. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 11.4 + 0.28 x 15.4) x 1.0 + 0.80 = 16.6620 + 0.80 = 17.4620. Refund = 20.87 - 17.4620 = 3.4080, rounded up to SGD 3.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and is 16.3% of charged_total, below the 90% that would make it a FULL_REFUND. POL-RD-09 adds nothing separate: there are no ERP gantry lines, no airport surcharge, no waiting fee and no promo, so nothing is double-counted. On the rider's plea of SGD 2.50, the contested sum is the rider's own estimate, not the policy measure; POL-RD-02 defines the refund as charged_total less the recomputed fare, and on this fare that is SGD 3.45.

OUTCOME. PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 3.45 to the rider; no driver compensation and no referrals. The monetary effect is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue. All artifacts carrying the deciding facts sit at full weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
